title: Immunohistochemistry and High Resolution Microscopy of Rat Gastric Nerve Fibers
author: Billie Hunne
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xz8fp9w

steps.title: Anesthetize and perfuse rats
steps.instruction: Inject rats intraperitoneally with ketamine (55 mg/kg) and xylazine (9 mg/kg), then perform transcardial perfusion using heparinised PBS (0.15 M NaCl, 0.01 M sodium phosphate buffer, pH 7.2) followed by fixative (2 % formaldehyde, 0.2 % picric acid in 0.1 M sodium phosphate buffer, pH 7.0).

steps.title: Post‑fix and clear stomach tissue
steps.instruction: Dissect the stomach, post‑fix overnight at 4 °C in the same fixative, then wash 3 × 10 min in dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) and 3 × 10 min in PBS.

steps.title: Cryoprotect, embed, and freeze tissue
steps.instruction: Store the tissue in PBS‑sucrose‑azide (30 % sucrose, 0.1 % sodium azide in PBS) at 4 °C, equilibrate overnight at 4 °C in a 1:1 mixture of PBS‑sucrose‑azide and OCT compound, then embed in OCT and freeze.

steps.title: Cut sections and block
steps.instruction: Cut 50 µm cryosections, place them as free‑floating sections in PBS in a 48‑well plate, aspirate PBS and add blocking solution (10 % normal horse serum, 1 % Triton‑X100 in PBS) and incubate for 3 nights at 4 °C.

steps.title: Incubate with primary antibodies
steps.instruction: Add a mixture of three primary antibodies (from different species) to each section and incubate for 3 nights at 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash and add secondary antibodies
steps.instruction: Aspirate primary antibodies, wash sections 3 × 10 min with PBS, then incubate with an appropriate mixture of Alexa‑fluor‑labelled secondary antibodies for a further 3 nights at 4 °C.

steps.title: Mount sections with antifade
steps.instruction: Mount sections onto slides using ProLong Diamond Antifade Mountant (Life Technologies), cover with #1.5 thickness coverslips, and seal edges with nail polish. Prepare parallel sections omitting primary antibodies as negative controls.

steps.title: Acquire Airyscan images of cells
steps.instruction: Image free‑floating sections on a Zeiss LSM880. Obtain a low‑resolution preview scan in the cell‑body channel, select 10 cells from the top half and 10 from the bottom half of the mucosa per section (2 sections per animal, 4 animals), then acquire super‑resolution z‑stacks of each cell in all three channels using fast Airyscan mode with a 20× oil objective, 6× zoom (70 × 70 µm field of view) through the entire section.

steps.title: Deconvolve images and quantify distances
steps.instruction: Process images with Zeiss Zen 3‑D Airyscan deconvolution, import into Imaris, render a 3‑D surface for each labelled object, apply the Distance Transformation XTension to generate a heat‑map of pixel distances (µm) from each cell edge to the nearest nerve‑fiber surface, and export the distance data to Excel.
